legacy_21_06_2026.interpretation: Regression-only input retained as the default until a new canonical manifest and Gates A-D validate.

hf_pt2_candidate.interpretation: HF_PT2 is a 3M-event pipeline-validation campaign, not physics. It is a canonical_candidate so the merge-consuming plotting path can be exercised end to end; publication_eligible is forced false and outputs must be regenerated from HF_RUN3_V1 before any paper use. The four cluster-resident paths are absolute because the merged product lives outside the checkout; this row is therefore Nikhef-specific by construction. It is NOT the active dataset: select it with DATASET_SELECTOR=config/dataset_selector_hf_pt2.json so the legacy regression default and its diagnostic target stay intact.

hf_pt2_int_candidate.interpretation: HF_PT2_INT is the 10M-event intermediate pipeline-validation campaign, not physics. It exists as a dataset row to discharge B6: the thnsparse and audit-subsamples plotting targets could not run at all because no hf_pt2_int dataset existed in either selector. It is a canonical_candidate so the merge-consuming plotting path can be exercised against a larger sample than HF_PT2; publication_eligible is forced false and outputs must be regenerated from HF_RUN3_V1 before any paper use. The four cluster-resident paths are absolute because the merged product lives outside the checkout, so this row is Nikhef-specific by construction. It is NOT the active dataset in the default selector: select it with DATASET_SELECTOR=config/dataset_selector_hf_pt2_int.json so the legacy regression default and its diagnostic target stay intact. Its merged directories are the ones first contact validated read-only: complete_root_HF_PT2_INT_MONASH and SUBSAMPLES_HF_PT2_INT/combined_root_subSamples_MONASH.

hf_run3_v1_candidate.interpretation: HF_RUN3_V1 is the physics campaign and the first dataset whose merged product declares analysis_schema paul_pair_objects_primary_ground_v3. SEALED AND AUTHORIZED 2026-08-17: status canonical, publication_eligible true, per docs/HF_RUN3_V1_PUBLICATION_AUTHORIZATION.md and the session record docs/history/CAMPAIGN_SEAL_SESSION_20260817c.md. All three tunes are merged (33/33 legs, one closure PASS each) and the freeze at campaigns/HF_RUN3_V1/freeze/ carries 3000 rows verified against the bytes on disk. The four paths are absolute because the merged product lives outside the checkout, so this row is Nikhef-specific by construction. The key retains the _candidate suffix deliberately: it is exported as HADRONIZATION_DATASET_ID and may appear in provenance already written, so renaming it would orphan those records -- the key is an identifier, status carries the claim.
